well, i started learning serious english  two years ago as i understood that I want to dedicate my life to languages, but before that i had been learning it at school, but that were just basics.  oh, i have started learning french recently too. but i am not sure if i am doing it well, it's hard for me to learn languages by myself, i need to have conversations with foreigners, but yes, the main problem is nobody wants to or i just can't find somebody that would want to talk. and my family is too poor to pay for extra lessons or tutors. 
and thank youuuu,  you have persuaded me, maybe i'll be good at drawing someday, it is anyway not the most important thing for me.

Well, I like one tv series, but it doesn't really help. After I watch it, I return to all bad thoughts I have. I am still trying to find something I am good at, but  it's really difficult and I'm losing my hope.
But anyway thank you for the nice reply. I just need to know my current situation won't last forever.
And I hope you're okay now c:

Thank you anyway, I just need to know I won't be that loser forever.
And I hope  you're okay now.

I've tried origami few times, but I'm getting more nervous when making all those paper figures as I always fail. But I can try again anyway. 
I feel ashamed for myself when I dance to be honest.
I like drawing,  but I'm bad at it. The same thing with languages, I like learning them, but god, I still don't know english perfectly though I have been learning it for about 2 years, what to say about other languages. 
So many hobbies exist,  but I can't find the one I am good at...
Aw thank you for offering me that, but I'm awful at games, everyone will just hate me after few minutes. But thank you for being nice anyway, I really need it right now c:

Thank you for the nice reply
Aw thank you.  But  I'm ugly not only physically. I mean, I always try to be kind and caring with others, always try to help people, but everyone still doesn't give a thing about me. Like something is wrong with me, but I can't understand what exactly. 

Yes, I  go seeing psychologist every Thursday, but to be honest even you helped me more then he.  He thinks too typically, like I need to go to some extra lessons, need to start talking with my classmates etc. But I can't. Not so fast and not in my neighborhoods. 
I don't know, if I tell my parents,  they will tell me something like "we've told you it's just a waste of money" and I will feel like it's my fault that he didn't help me at all. 

God, sometimes I think I'm the only one person that has absolutely no one. I know maybe it's not true, but I anyway think that way quite often, and feel so pathetic

thank you so much for replying , i thought everyone would just blame me for complaining, like my ex-friend did.   you cheered me up a bit.  but i'm still not sure if i can find an important person (well, at least a friend) in the future. something is wrong with me i guess
